reviews.text:
They saved my cat and I'm very satisfied with the personal experience. They were amazing and very sweet.
Kind and kind.

The headquarters are basic, but the staff is very helpful and knowledgeable. The space and volunteers are dedicated to the recovery of sick or injured animals. They deserve more attention as an organization.
Excellent clinic! Dr. Franco is very knowledgeable, and thanks to her advice, my cat's health problems have been resolved. Thank you so much!

I entrusted myself to the ENPA clinic for a delicate tumor removal procedure on my dog. From the very first moment, we found an environment characterized by extreme kindness and professionalism. Special thanks go to Dr. Gardella, the surgeon Dr. Cristofaletti, and, for her more recent support, Irene Franco. The entire staff demonstrates the utmost attention and care for the patient. I highly recommend everyone to come to this facility for the health of their pets.

Wonderful people. That's all I can say! I found an injured pigeon on the street, I called, and they were able to take it in. (They don't always succeed due to the large number of pigeons.) I saw so much passion and expertise. Well done! 👏🏻
Trained and very kind staff, maximum availability and hospitality
Kind and competent in receiving a wild bird found on the ground unable to fly

⭐ A huge disappointment

I went to ENPA in Milan because my elderly dog ​​had been unwell for some time, and seeing him suffer makes me feel terrible. I turned to them precisely because I was hoping to find help and understanding, especially given my financial difficulties.

Unfortunately, my experience was very negative. My dog ​​received a shot, for which I paid about €150, which I was told was for pain relief. Unfortunately, at home, I saw no improvement. I was also prescribed medications and offered several tests, all of which cost money.

I fully understand that veterinary care is expensive and that tests can be necessary, but I expected a different approach, especially considering that I turned to ENPA precisely because I can no longer afford regular veterinary expenses.

I am a single mother and I adopted my dog ​​about four years ago because he was alone and I felt so sorry for him. Since then, he has become part of my family. Now that he's elderly and requires more care, I find myself in a difficult situation and was simply looking for someone who could help me find a sustainable solution so he doesn't suffer.

The thing that hurt me the most, however, was the way I felt treated. At an already very painful and worrying time for me, I needed at least some humanity, a listening ear, and understanding. Instead, I left there deeply disappointed and feeling like I hadn't been helped.

I don't question the work of veterinarians in general, but I'm judging my personal experience: for me, it was terrible, and unfortunately, I didn't feel welcomed or supported when I needed it most.

I sincerely hope that in the future they will also pay more attention to people who come asking for help because they can no longer afford their pet's care. Behind every dog ​​is a family, and sometimes what's needed is not just a prescription, but also a little understanding.
Welcoming, available, competent
Excellent and welcoming staff
Very kind, they gave me an appointment right away. We had a great time!

Rescued cat brought to ENPA they tell us that he is too old and to take him to the municipality of residence perhaps even euthanasia!!!?????? National Animal Protection Agency??????? Cost: 94 euros!!!!?????

Very helpful and kind. They helped me a lot with my cat. Thank you!
Special thanks to Dr. Avenia, who performed the surgery.
I went for a consultation. Satisfied.
Very good. Very competent orthopedic surgeon.
You must call before accessing
Doctors and staff (Lina) are very courteous and excellent, both on a human and professional level.

The staff was very kind and attentive.
I also found the doctor very helpful.
Thank you all.
The clinic offers unparalleled dedication and attention to the animals that come to the clinic, along with the utmost professionalism and helpfulness towards those who pick them up. A top rating.
Good and kind, I found two wood pigeons and delivered them to them.
We've been bringing our four-legged friends here for years. The staff is helpful and very knowledgeable. Excellent prices for vaccinations, visits, and surgeries.

They are wonderful people who will always have my utmost respect and admiration.
And my thanks for everything they do!!
Love for animals and understanding towards humans.

Excellent doctors... top-notch professionalism 👍....
Thanks to Dr. Irene Franco and the exquisite welcome from Ms. Lina.....at the reception...
This is my second dog that I've entrusted to this ENPA vet for any problem.
Thank you

ENPA
A big heart for the people who work there and for its always available medical professionals.
I've always received impeccable service and helpful, thoughtful advice.

My dog ​​is lucky, and so am I.
Thanks to the amazing people They saved my dog
I've always had a great time, the people are empathetic and always very helpful.

I didn't contact an expert, and I didn't get any feedback in the following days. I didn't get any help in reaching them or finding them, or any support or clarification regarding the situation of the animal, which was brought and delivered without a record. Only after writing and calling several times, 7 days later did they say they had received the animal from Vanzago.
ENPA told me they didn't even know who I was or what I had delivered! Terrible.
Prepared, empathetic, professional and honest

Disappointed with the service
I called animal rescue to report a pigeon stuck in a situation I couldn't handle alone. Despite the seriousness of the situation, the response was completely evasive and full of excuses for not coming to the rescue:
You do it yourself
We'll only go out; the animal is injured (isn't being in danger enough?)
There are only three of us (it's not my problem).
I understand the logistical difficulties, but the indifference shown is inconsistent with the association's mission. I hope this feedback helps improve emergency management, because today an animal was abandoned to its fate.
Clinic for injured birds, glad it exists ❤️

We went to the clinic on a holiday for an acquaintance's dog who was ill.
I found a truly humane, caring, and kind environment, as well as, of course, extraordinary expertise and professionalism, which I immediately noticed. I sincerely thank all the ENPA staff on Via Gassendi.
My special thanks go to the medical director, Irene Franco, who took our delicate situation to heart. Even though we hadn't booked an appointment, she welcomed us and helped this woman in need, reassuring her both financially and personally, as she was deeply distressed by seeing her dog ill. She also provided free dog food and care for her beloved Willy, who is starting to feel better today. I sincerely thank you for the impeccable professionalism and compassion I've experienced in this environment, which I recommend to anyone caring for an animal. I will definitely return for my own dog when I need it.
I've been to this clinic twice. I must say they're very good, kind, and competent. They're my lifeline. Very good.
Excellent experience and a very empathetic and professional environment. Thanks also to the very busy secretary Lina!
Well-maintained place. We get along very well with Dr. Irene Franco.
Excellent assistance, great empathy and understanding.
I had a great experience at this veterinary clinic and found Dr. Bruno to be both courteous and professional. I highly recommend it.

I've been taking my dog ​​for years. The staff is knowledgeable, attentive, and helpful, covering all specialties. Dr. Franco is always kind and gives me peace of mind. Prices are lower than average, with excellent service quality. Recommended.

Competent, kind, and very helpful staff; I've been taking my cat there for several years and have always been satisfied.
The facility is equipped with the equipment to perform various diagnostic tests quickly, which avoids unnecessary travel and wasted time.
I have no basis for comparing them to market prices, but as an ENPA facility, I'm confident that the proceeds will be reinvested in the care and protection of less fortunate animals, which I believe is a fundamental added value.

Always kind and professional
We are happy to be welcomed with such great professionalism.

As far as I'm concerned, ENPA, in addition to having an excellent team, is the only reliable veterinary clinic for the care and health of my dog ​​and has been my point of reference for about 12 years.

On the phone, you're very cold, dismissive, hasty, and unwilling to listen, bordering on arrogance. If you respond like this to users who care about the fate of a puppy (even a feral one), then (perhaps) you're in the wrong place.
I had a great time, everyone is super friendly and kind and treats our furry little children in a very sweet way.

Good morning, I've been an ENPA member for many years. I'm very satisfied with the professionalism of the veterinarians and the care they provide to their young patients.
Special mention goes to the secretary, who is always very patient and helpful.
The clinic is always available. Lina at the reception is kind and professional. Dr. Decaminada is number one. Thank you for always being there for our little ones.
Very fast and effective

Already familiar with ENPA's extraordinary work in helping and rescuing rescued animals, I used the in-house veterinary clinic for the first time for my cat, and I was consistently impressed with the care, attention, and professionalism of the veterinary staff. Special thanks to Drs. Irene Franco and Alice Meregalli.
We had a great time. Thank you very much.
What can I say... courtesy, humanity, clarity, empathy... all the best adjectives... and super affordable prices!!!

I was very satisfied with the service. Dr. Irene Franco examined my puppies with great care, immediately putting them at ease.
During the visits, she administered the necessary vaccinations with great professionalism, first the first dose and then the booster.
I really appreciated her kindness, her willingness to explain everything clearly, and the care she showed towards the animals.
A truly positive experience, I recommend this place to anyone looking for competent people who care about the well-being of our four-legged friends. See you at ENPA ❤️
They are not helping at all
Very polite and very helpful especially Dr. Jovanovska was very kind and very helpful an

Both the doctors and the rest of the staff are kind and helpful.
They have treated (and sometimes saved) my dog ​​on several occasions, and I am always grateful for their skill and humanity.
Highly recommended 🐾🐾🫶 …

All my cats—and there have been quite a few over the years—have grown up in the care of this clinic, which has always treated them with great care and sensitivity. The skill of the individual veterinarians is complemented by the convenience of having the clinic available almost full-time for emergencies, and the opportunity to have many specialists on site. Furthermore, when I have had to care for abandoned and vulnerable kittens, I have received professional assistance and a certain degree of financial consideration. So far, for me, it's been the best.
Excellent experience for the visit and vaccinations. The staff were kind and friendly, and the cat was very calm. I highly recommend them for everything, hygiene, and pricing.
ENPA Veterinary Structure

The staff is very sensitive and dedicated to their work. I brought my cat who hadn't been feeling well for days, and we were able to find the right treatment here! There's a high ethical standard in this work, and it's fully respected here.
Thank you for everything.

I started bringing my cat here after finding him, as a kitten, in the trunk of my car (thanks also to the help of ENPA). From that moment on, I relied on them for any need.
They've always been super helpful, kind, and very competent. You can really see the love and care they put into their work. A fundamental point of reference for me and my cat. Highly recommended!
Great, kind, and very professional. Thank you all.
The staff is always very helpful, professional, and knowledgeable. Reasonable prices. Wide availability of appointments.

Heartfelt thanks to the esteemed Dr. Decaminada, who has been caring for my beloved dogs for years. She is knowledgeable, helpful, and kind, and my Isa was safe in her arms. A rare quality, but one I increasingly recognize and appreciate, is the ability to offer a point of view without imposing it on others like the Truth, and the willingness to collaborate and engage with colleagues. Thanks also to her, my dog ​​was able to receive the best possible care and go home peacefully, among those who loved her.
A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Franco, who for a long weekend was our guiding light and loving guide.
G. Pagliaro

The staff was very professional, attentive, and loving with our kittens, making us and our cats feel completely at ease.
We are truly grateful for the attention and affection they gave us.
We highly recommend their services to anyone who wants the best for their pets!

I've been entrusting my furry friends to their care for years now, and my experience has always been beyond positive!
Great attention and empathy, the doctor who looks after us has always been super helpful and present.
Thank you!

I brought my cat Ettorino to the clinic in terrible condition. He was at risk of amputation on his hind leg, which was the worst affected. They operated on him immediately, and two days later they also operated on his front leg. Complications arose, but the staff didn't give up; on the contrary, they did everything they could, and in the end, thanks to their professionalism, humanity, and tenacity in saving his leg, they performed a miracle.
We will always be grateful to all the staff, special people with huge hearts in doing their job.
Ettore and his owners extend their heartfelt thanks to the staff.
Ettore, who has no voice, thanks all the staff in particular, shouting out his heartfelt thanks, and finally returning to play and jump as if nothing had happened. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
Attention to the public cat and other animals, 10 cum laude 🙏first class service, empathía 10+ …

I went for a serious problem with my dog. They welcomed me like I was a friend, both at the reception and at the vets. Excellent staff.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

I went to the ENPA clinic for the first time this year, with two kittens adopted from a shelter, and I met professional, helpful, and humane veterinarians. My family and I received great care during the illness of one of the two kittens, and thanks to the veterinarians' professionalism and dedication, the
kitten recovered.
We've always found them very helpful with any needs, so much so that the clinic has become a point of reference for us today, and we're very grateful to all the staff!
Antonella

I took my cat Clio for her first visit to the EMPA Veterinary Clinic in Milan and had a wonderful time! Dr. Irene is incredibly kind, attentive, and gentle with animals, and the entire staff is also extremely friendly and helpful. There's a calm and welcoming atmosphere, where you can immediately sense that the people who work here truly love animals. Clio was treated with great kindness and professionalism. I absolutely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy place for their pet.

The doctors are extremely professional, and you can tell they love animals. They are extremely helpful and available. We were treated by Dr. Irene, who was very knowledgeable and thorough. Highly recommended.
Courteous and competent.

"I would like to express my deepest gratitude and admiration for the ENPA Veterinary Clinic in Milan and its staff. The courtesy and professionalism with which they care for my dog ​​Simba is truly exceptional! Thank you for the attention and care you give to our four-legged friends. You are an example of excellence in the veterinary field! Thank you so much!"
Kind, punctual and caring with people and especially with animals
Professional and very empathetic doctors, we had a great experience. Thanks again.
My vets have always been my go-to vets. They're very good, very attentive to my dog, loving, and competent. I really like them and will always go to ENPA.
Top

It's impossible to reach the number; both the clinic and the emergency room are always busy. And to make matters worse, there's no waiting list! I have an emergency and can't get through, so my rating is low!
Very knowledgeable and kind, they are helping me a lot with my puppy who has a tumor. Highly recommended.

Professionalism, availability, simply unique, thanks to all the staff
Sabra Re
I have always brought my animals here to ENPA, I have always found it very good, I have always found professional, kind and very helpful people, I am very satisfied
Very kind and competent veterinarians

Best veterinary clinic, extremely kind and friendly.
I had a really good experience, and my cat is currently being treated there.

A truly positive experience. Excellent welcome, truly skilled vet. I examined Teo, a friend's big dog, with great care. An echocardiogram was performed by a very good ultrasound specialist. The cost was reasonable compared to other clinics. And the skill of the two doctors is indescribable. If you have a furry friend (dog, kitten, bunny), go to this clinic with your eyes closed. You'll be happy, but above all, your furry friends will be treated with love. 💯
Always available. A certainty

I have a 5-month-old Scottish Fold who needs special care, and every time I contact ENPA Milano, I find an extraordinary team: empathetic, attentive, and truly caring—not only with our little furry friends, but also with us owners. Always available, professional, and with a rare humanity. A true point of reference. 🐾 …

I've been a client of the clinic for years, having had several surgeries, and I immediately felt comfortable with the staff, especially Dr. Avenia, because they are very empathetic with both me and my little furry friend.
Highly recommended clinic.
Very knowledgeable and friendly staff
I have always taken my animals to them, a team of truly professional and very kind doctors, always ready to take care of us and advise us on what is best for them. TOP

I want to share with you all my very positive experience at the ENPA clinic, where they welcomed us as if they'd known us forever.
They were very helpful and, above all, attentive to my little dog's needs.
Trained and helpful staff.
Bad experience with the wildlife rescue reception
As always, wonderful. We found a crow with a broken leg and they took it in.

An exceptional veterinary clinic, with skilled doctors who care about the animal's well-being first and foremost. We've been bringing our kitten here for two years now—she was in really bad shape when we found her, and they immediately treated her with the best care possible—and we've met several doctors and staff: they're all kind and passionate about furry friends! A special mention goes to Dr. Irene, who treats our little girl and combines her helpfulness and a big smile with her extensive medical expertise!
Thank you for all you do

At ENPA in Milan, I met a wonderful person, Dr. Irene Franco, who is not only highly professional and competent, but has maintained a humanity and kindness rarely encountered. She saved my 12-day-old puppy, and I will always be grateful for her kindness and the attentive, meticulous care she gave my dog. I highly recommend Dr. Irene Franco and ENPA in Milan.

The ENPA clinic is very good... great professionals.
Dr. Eloisa Ticozzi

Terrible. A doctor wanted to vaccinate my dog ​​without telling me why or explaining anything. I asked her to check the record and she agreed, as the vaccine had already been administered. You pay €40 for a three-minute pseudo-checkup. Unprofessional and incompetent. They try to get you to come back multiple times, each time using the excuse of mandatory tests, vaccinations, etc., so you end up paying €50. I had to ask for an invoice and a certificate of the "visit," otherwise... if you love your pets, stay away from this center.
Very helpful, they waited for me even after closing

We found an injured mini hare lying in the middle of the road. We visited several veterinary clinics, but they all asked for payment, and some even told us that "mini hares are very fragile and don't survive," just to send us away.

We placed her in a box with a blanket and kept her safe overnight, hoping she would make it. In the morning, she was better: her little eye had healed and she was moving more, although her head was still tilted due to the trauma.

At 9 a.m., we called ENPA, and a very kind woman answered and explained that the visit would be free. Once she was there, we filled out a form and they confirmed that the hare wasn't in serious condition. Now they will take care of her, and once she's healed, she will be released back into the wild.

It couldn't have gone better! Thank you, ENPA, for your availability, professionalism, and love for wild animals.
Very knowledgeable and helpful. I brought them a sparrow I found in distress. It was immediately admitted and then transferred to the CRAS in Vanzago.

I want to leave an extremely positive review for the ENPA clinic, which demonstrated great professionalism, compassion, and dedication in caring for a swift I found in a residential building.

From the very first moment, the staff was helpful, reassuring, and competent, ensuring the little bird was fed, hydrated, and supported in the best possible way.

I'm happy to hear that he's doing well and will soon be released into the WWF sanctuary in Vanzago. Heartfelt thanks to all the staff for the invaluable work you do with passion and care!

It's a shame I can't visit him, but the good news is that he's healthy and free.
Effective

I found an injured hen and brought her to them. They welcomed her with great care and professionalism, cared for her with care, and then transferred her to a sanctuary for further treatment. Thank you so much.
I brought a swift that couldn't fly and I know for sure that I left it in good hands

I thank the entire ENPA team for saving another little life.
My cat had attacked a pigeon that had flown onto the balcony and had clearly injured it, leaving it unable to fly away.
I took this little pigeon to ENPA, where they took care of it. After being treated and cared for within a week, it was released and able to fly freely again. To the doctors, their assistants, and the volunteers at ENPA, who rescue and care for domestic and wild animals every day, I extend my deepest gratitude. I have voluntarily left them a small contribution to support the need for medicine and supplies to provide dignified care for any animal in need who comes to ENPA.
I took a family of swallows there that had unfortunately fallen from their nest. The staff were professional. Thank you for the wonderful work you do.

On July 2nd, when we returned home, we found a baby redstart in a corner of the balcony (redstarts had made a nest near our house, in the condominium courtyard). It was clearly in distress, disheveled, dehydrated, affected by the fiery sunset light, and above all, its leg seemed broken, bent in an unnatural direction. It was after 8:00 PM, we contacted ENPA, and at that time the answering machine was active, so we left a message. After a night spent doing our best to feed and protect it, the next morning we were promptly contacted by ENPA, who had listened to our message. We agreed to entrust the chick to them, and so we did. Elisa, very kind and thoughtful, welcomed us. After filling out a form, she also gave us the veterinary clinic's email address, where we could write to receive updates on the animals delivered. We parted amid hopeful smiles; I contacted the clinic for the first time a few days later, and they promptly told me that the redstart was still under observation, so I could contact them later if we wish. Today, we plucked up the courage to send another email requesting information, and the response was immediate. The little one is doing well, has been hydrated and supported, and has already been transferred to the WWF oasis in Vanzago, where he will be released as soon as possible. We thank the entire ENPA team for the professionalism, love, and kindness with which they welcomed us and the little redstart in need. We will never forget it! Thank you so much 💛 Sara and Claudio

I want to thank ENPA in Milan from the bottom of my heart. I found a little blackbird crying for help, and they were the only ones who gave me a prompt response! They were incredibly kind, welcoming me right away and securing the little one. They even allowed me to write to see how he was doing, and they responded immediately, kindly, and explained everything to me thoroughly. Every life matters!!! And they know it...and they teach us. THANK YOU FROM THE BOTTOM OF MY HEART.
Highly experienced veterinarians. Open 24/7. Veterinary clinic for both domestic and wild animals.

We found a baby great tit on our front porch, hiding among the plants. After giving her some water to hydrate her, we took her to the clinic where she was examined and lovingly cared for. Without their care, she would not have survived, and she is now in a WWF sanctuary. My heartfelt thanks to the ENPA volunteers.
Extremely kind and professional in receiving and assisting a kestrel chick in need and extremely helpful in providing post-hospitalization information...

3 words
Cleanliness, efficiency, and courtesy!

I brought a baby blackbird I found alone and unable to fly in my backyard. It was 9:00 PM, outside of the clinic's opening hours, but I was still greeted kindly. They took the little bird in, hydrated and fed it, and sent it to a WWF sanctuary. I want to thank you for your invaluable work.
We handed over a swift we found in our apartment building. We were met with great courtesy and expertise. He was treated, and Pipino is now in a WWF sanctuary. Thank you!

I brought a small injured pigeon
Thank you for what you do! You are an important point of reference for these little animals 🫶🏻❣️ …

I brought a starling that had been attacked by a crow, pecked on the head several times.
The ENPA staff was very kind, and a few days later, when I emailed to check on him, they replied that he was fine and had been transferred to the WWF oasis. Excellent assistance and friendliness.
Congratulations!
This is the second bird I've brought here. The first, a blackbird, was cared for and released. Yesterday, a baby pigeon arrived at 8:00 PM and was taken into care.
Very kind and super helpful guys.
Kindness, helpfulness, and professionalism. Highly recommended!
Friendly and professional staff
Always available
I brought a baby crow, well done!
professionalism and courtesy.

I trusted them for 12 years, even though I moved house I always went back there, but the last time they ignored my reports about my dog's health (they only aim for expensive interventions), after a week my dog ​​passed away, I wouldn't even bring an ant.

Good place however they do not seem to care about the fact that you bring fledgling birds. You are treated like an inhuman person. I hope they will take care of the Great Tit, Parus Major I brought. Also once you give the animal, not sure you are able to visit him/her again.

I couldn't even manage a few words with the vet without being interrupted by other staff, and without even looking at my dog, she asked me if I wanted to pay before or after the visit. Not to mention the secretary who was cursing because the phone wouldn't stop ringing.
The only place where I could drop off found pigeons. Pigeons have it very hard in Milan. Thank you so much ENPA for existing 🙏🙏 …

This morning I brought a newborn magpie to ENPA (which they call a swift but I'm pretty sure it's a magpie...) and received one of the most vulgar treatments since I started volunteering. I'm a veterinary student and I know what I'm doing. I don't follow random instructions found online, but what Lorenzo Crosta (not an ornithologist, but THE exotics vet par excellence) told me, and I managed to feed and keep the little one alive all night. In the morning I brought him to them thinking I was doing the right thing for him, and he was snatched from my hands. I was judged as if I'd done everything wrong, as if I should never have cared for him (you're locked up at night otherwise he would have been brought to you sooner, eh...). When I repeat, I fed him regularly with A21, which is neither too high nor too low in protein for him, and I kept him in a warm room, that's all. They looked me up and down, called me a liar and ignorant. NEVER in my life have I been subjected to that, considering that the little bird is doing fine, and so are all the others I've saved. Who do you think you are? Unfortunately, I was too shocked to react at the time, but I wanted to report the matter because I find it serious and unacceptable. You shouldn't allow yourself to treat people like this, much less someone who has always been committed and educated to helping these animals. Good luck.

They truly love animals...and it shows!
They become as attached to your puppies as aunts, and are always available and keep a watchful eye on the furry ones they care for...highly recommended! They helped us save a 300g kitten...who is now here, beautifully healthy, at 5kg of muscle and feline superiority ❤️

I've already brought two birds to them, and they're always ready to welcome them. Once, they waited for me past closing time because I'd called them urgently 20 minutes before closing time and wasn't sure I'd make it in time.

While passing through Milan, we were referred to ENPA for a sudden problem with our dog.
We were greeted with kindness and professionalism, receiving effective treatment and helpful advice for the future.
We and Jack thank you for your help. Thank you!
The clinic is a wonderful place with wonderful people. They're competent, helpful, and very kind. Our puppies are cared for and pampered.

I thought it was a serious and professional organization, I'll start by saying that my vet works at ENPA, she's very professional and has a heart, but that said, the organization doesn't have the same characteristics. I booked an appointment to operate on my dog, I asked to be present during the sedation process since she comes from a shelter. The night before, I received a message telling me to go by 9, fill out the consent form and maybe stay in the area and then be called, but for me, staying in the area means an hour and a half, not half a morning with the dog fasting and not even able to drink... anyway, very annoyed, I agreed to return at 12, with obvious organizational disruption to the day. My husband takes me back to the clinic at 12 and then I would have had to go home by taxi because he was going to work and I no longer had a car... I enter the clinic, I stay outside the room because I'm on the phone with a person to whom I was telling liters about the messy morning I was having and the reason, I finish the call, I sit next to two people with whom I exchange a few words and one of the clients tells me ... the animal world is a business nowadays..... in the meantime the SECRETARY REPLIES TO ME MRS "WE TOLD YOU WHY YOU HAD TO COME BACK AT THIS TIME".... AND I REPLY YES OF COURSE IT'S A SHAME THAT ON AN ORGANIZATIONAL LEVEL I FOUND MYSELF HAVING TO REORGANIZING EVERYTHING AND RETURN HOME BY TAXI BECAUSE I LIVE FAR AWAY AND THEREFORE AN ADDITIONAL EXPENSE...... REPLY FROM THE SECRETARY AND HERE YOU CAN SEE WHERE HER PROFESSIONALISM IS..... ..."IF YOU DON'T HAVE THE MONEY TO KEEP A DOG YOU DON'T TAKE IT" ...... COMPLIMENTS APART FROM THE FACT THAT MY DOGS ARE TAKEN FROM KENNELS AND ASSOCIATIONS..... BUT YOU SHOULD NOT ALLOW YOURSELF TO SPEAK LIKE THAT TO A CLIENT .....anyway they make me sit down with an excuse in a clinic and the medical director and the surgeon arrive and tell me that I cannot allow myself to defame the clinic .....and that I would be sued ......all because I complained and two clients were in the waiting room ..moreover they also sued me for aggressive and arrogant tones.....(which I asked the two external clients when they made me leave and obviously the clients nodded that I had not been arrogant or aggressive) certainly nervous I admit, at that point I reply "okay now but operate on my dog ​​and do a good job since it was the second operation he had to undergo due to a first mistake CLEARLY NOT MADE BY ENPA", I am told no that the assumptions of trust had lapsed .......anyway in all this, in addition to having lost my dog ​​fasting and without water since the night before, I had considered ENPA a professional body, and To the receptionist who dared to tell me that if I don't have the money, I shouldn't afford to get a dog, I'd like to tell her that perhaps she's in the wrong job, and that she shouldn't be allowed to count my money because I've always done everything I could for my dogs' well-being, even though I was sometimes in financial difficulty. So, denigrating a client like that in front of strangers is definitely a reason for a lawsuit.

So, if you're looking for a professional clinic and perhaps your dog's well-being is your primary goal, this isn't it.
They are very organized in case of need, unfortunately it is located in area B

When we called for an urgent need regarding a 5-meter snake at our company (NOT IN THE COUNTRYSIDE), the response was:

"So? Just as it came, it's gone."

I said, "At least see what kind of snake it is." I sent a video on WhatsApp, but after three days, no one has seen it yet.
Very kind and helpful

My dog ​​Tommy underwent surgery for a hernia that paralyzed his legs 3 years ago with the help of ENPA Milan, which covered the cost of the surgery. Dr. Irene has a big heart and God put her on our path. A heartfelt thank you to all of you. Nicoleta Alexa

The right place if you truly love animals. Animals are a necessity, not a luxury. Thank you, ENPA.
SHAME ON Brambilla and those who stand on HER SIDE!
